{{Short description|Field of applied statistics}}
{{for|the academic journal|Spatial Statistics}}

[[File:USA_Contiguous_Poverty_2020_clusters.jpg | thumb | right | Map of poverty clusters in the United States made using spatial statistics.]]
'''Spatial statistics''' is a field of [[applied statistics]] dealing with [[spatial data]].
It involves [[stochastic process]]es ([[random field]]s, [[point process]]es), [[sampling (statistics)|sampling]], [[smoothing]] and [[interpolation]], [[regional]] ([[areal unit]]) and [[lattice (group)|lattice]] ([[gridded data|gridded]]) data, [[point pattern]]s, as well as [[image analysis]] and [[stereology]].<ref name="Ripley 2005 p. ">{{cite book | last=Ripley | first=B.D. | title=Spatial Statistics | publisher=Wiley | series=Wiley Series in Probability and Statistics | year=2005 | isbn=978-0-471-72520-6 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=BDDPTdohXeYC | access-date=2023-04-04 | page=}}</ref><ref name="van Lieshout 2019 p. ">{{cite book | last=van Lieshout | first=M.N.M. | title=Theory of Spatial Statistics: A Concise Introduction | publisher=CRC Press | series=Chapman & Hall/CRC Texts in Statistical Science | year=2019 | isbn=978-0-429-62867-2 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=WPaODwAAQBAJ | access-date=2023-04-04 | page=}}</ref><ref name="Cressie 2015 p. ">{{cite book | last=Cressie | first=N. | title=Statistics for Spatial Data | publisher=Wiley | series=Wiley Series in Probability and Statistics | year=2015 | isbn=978-1-119-11518-2 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=MzN_BwAAQBAJ | access-date=2023-04-04 | page=}}</ref><ref name="Gelfand Diggle Guttorp Fuentes 2010 p. ">{{cite book | last1=Gelfand | first1=A.E. | last2=Diggle | first2=P. | last3=Guttorp | first3=P. | last4=Fuentes | first4=M. | title=Handbook of Spatial Statistics | publisher=CRC Press | series=Chapman & Hall/CRC Handbooks of Modern Statistical Methods | year=2010 | isbn=978-1-4200-7288-4 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Xf4leslPDzsC | access-date=2023-04-04 | page=}}</ref>
